rules.early-economy-deficit: R200 collected gems <75% of opponent (opponent >=20), or earned gold <75% (opponent >=200).
rules.collection-deficit: Final collected gems trail by >=150; includes pickups and recycled dropped gems, not pure farming.
rules.death-imbalance: At least eight deaths and at least twice the opponent deaths.
rules.pvp-bag-loss: At least 100 gems lost to champions and at least twice the opponent PvP gem losses.
rules.camp-mortality: At least two camp deaths, accounting for >=25% of our deaths.
rules.unconverted-winning-total: Final held gems plus banked gems >=1000, banked <1000. Does not establish safe bank access or a missed legal winning turn.
rules.conversion-deficit: Collected >=90% of opponent, submitted <70% of opponent; opponent banked >=200.
rules.zero-zero-gold-loss: Both teams banked zero and outcome was the gold tiebreak.
rules.early-bruiser-mismatch: Opponent bought >=5 Bruiser shards by R300 while we bought zero. Different builds can be valid; needs an intervention test.
rules.same-hero-economy-gap: A shared Vesper/Marcella earns <60% of its opposite number, whose gold >=750.
rules.boss-gate-unresolved: boss_battle zero-bank-with-resources and no camp-clear event for our team on group16.
rules.stampede-no-gems: stampede: our collected gems zero and opponent collected >=160.
rules.fuel-exhaustion-observed: At least one fuel-exhausted event; zero runtime faults does not make fuel exhaustion a proven cause.
rules.isolated-outnumbered-deaths: At least two deaths with no ally and >=2 enemies within eight tiles in omniscient replay; visibility at decision time is not inferred.
rules.repeat-deaths-after-respawn: At least three deaths within 60 rounds of a detected respawn (initial deployment excluded).
rules.near-home-death-pressure: At least three deaths within Chebyshev15 of observed spawn tiles, with an enemy within eight.
rules.cooldowns-spent-on-camps-before-contact: At least three visible-contact entries where an offensive ability remained on cooldown after an observed camp-targeted cast.
rules.contact-with-no-offensive-ready: At least ten contact entries; >=35% have no offensive ability ready and exceed opponent rate by >=10 percentage points. Ready does not mean legal or useful.
rules.long-stationary-interval: At least one >=80-round stationary interval outside spawn without observed movement, attacks, casts or bank/recall starts. Could be deliberate camping/capture; manual review required.
